Name: Relaxing Greenhouse
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Replaces the greenhouse with this Relaxing Greenhouse.
Water source in both the pond and the fountain, animated fountain.

The beautiful fountain was created by  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182201142]TangaS2[/url]   and animated by me.
Heartfelt thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182201142]TangaS2[/url] that allowed me to publish it.

Installation: Remove the old and install the new.
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder.

Here is the video.
[url=http://]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20130?tab=videos#lg=2&slide=0[/url]

Version 1.0.7 Enlarged by one tile below the lower space for planting trees as requested.
Version 1.0.8 Allowed giant crops.

I thank in advance anyone who believes that my work deserves at least the time to give a thumbs up.
